source: Union of Core operations invoked by the retired Swift (platform/macos) and C# (platform/windows) hosts, excluding their *Checks.* harnesses, recorded at 030f2dd1 before those hosts were deleted (#996). Fixed; never regenerate.

electronShared.agentCapabilities: Electron validates Harness capabilities inside Core harnessHandshake (hello) and harnessReceive (status results); the host never reads raw capabilities outside those operations.
electronShared.attentionPlanCurrent: Core attentionCompletion applies attentionPlanCurrent when Electron settles a synthesis turn; each finding commits under revision-exact delivery receipts, and planning and claiming are synchronous, so there is no separate pre-claim window to check.
electronShared.companionShouldRotate: Electron keeps Fox's conversation turns in world.sqlite (companion_turns, owner decision 2026-10-03), so the profile file holds no turns to rotate.
electronShared.companionPersonaPrompt: Electron builds the Fox prompt with Core companionPrompt, which composes companionPersonaPrompt with the archive's memories.
electronShared.companionValidID: Electron validates whole companion archives with Core companionValidate, which applies the same ID rule to the identity and every record.
electronShared.companionValidTimestamp: Electron validates whole companion archives with Core companionValidate, which applies the same timestamp rule to the identity and every record.
electronShared.interruptsBackground: Electron decides foreground priority and background preemption per Agent request through Core foregroundAgentWork, agentWorkPriority, preemptAgentWork and nextAgentWork, and attention admission through Core admitBackgroundWork; the pool holds only Agent requests, so the UI-request classifier does not apply.
electronShared.modelStatusFresh: Electron renders the shared UI, whose model-status reader (platform/bridge/model-status.ts) caches ready results with Core modelStatusFresh and is invalidated by Core changesModelStatus in platform/bridge/host.ts.
electronShared.agentWorkPriority: Only Worldlet's built-in Hermes runtime scheduled model work and handed off Harness sign-ins; it was removed (2026-10-09: no built-in Agent), and a person's own Harness does both itself.
electronShared.foregroundAgentWork: Only Worldlet's built-in Hermes runtime scheduled model work and handed off Harness sign-ins; it was removed (2026-10-09: no built-in Agent), and a person's own Harness does both itself.
